items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: let me play in the orchestra with my dad, you know, and Mr. Hartz

ctx.x: And I shall never forget, there were certain women, like older women at the church, you know, they just thought it was awful. Finally, when my mother did consent to let me play in the orchestra with my dad, you know, and Mr. Hartz, they said, "I think it's awful for that little girl." "That little girl is playing jazz music, and I think it's terrible. She's going to hell."
